title: Integer to Bit Converter
text: Map vector of integers to vector of bits, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Output data type} sets Output data type Inherit via internal; {Number of bits per integer(M)}, {Treat input values as} and {Output bit order}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In
ports.summary: Input signal integer | column vector of integers

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: Output signal bit scalar | column vector of bits

params.name: Number of bits per integer(M)
params.values: Number of bits per integer 3 (default) | integer in the range [1, 32]

params.name: Treat input values as
params.values: Treat input values as Unsigned (default) | Signed

params.name: Output bit order
params.values: Output bit order MSB first (default) | LSB first
